decision.reason: The only evidence, a single changelog line [ev-1c5771548249], says the bundled Helm was upgraded to 3.17.0 (PR #21722). That gives a likely subject (the bundled Helm dependency) and the new version. It does not give the previous version, what behavior changed, which environments are exposed (for example, Helm-sourced applications) or what happens to an operator who does nothing. To fill these in, we need the PR #21722 description or the upgrade guide and Helm release notes covering the version jump.
